editorial:
Imagine being a top CIA agent who suddenly gets accused of being a Russian spy. That's exactly what happens to Evelyn Salt, played by Angelina Jolie. She's tough, smart, and incredibly skilled at her job. When a Russian defector walks into the CIA and claims she's a sleeper agent, her whole world flips upside down. Instead of waiting to be arrested, she runs. The movie throws you right into the action as Salt uses every trick she knows to stay ahead of her own team. You never quite know if she's innocent or guilty, and that mystery keeps you guessing the whole time. It's a fast, exciting ride with lots of twists.

The action scenes are really well done, with great stunts and chase sequences that feel real and intense. Angelina Jolie carries the movie with a strong, physical performance that makes you believe she could actually do all this. The pacing rarely slows down, which is great if you want pure entertainment. On the downside, the plot gets a little confusing at times, and some twists feel a bit over the top. If you love spy thrillers and non-stop action, this is a fun pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn that Salt was indeed trained as a Russian sleeper agent as a child, but she turned against her handlers after they killed her husband. She infiltrates the Russian president's security detail and stops an assassination attempt, then goes after the man who ordered her husband's death. In the end, she surrenders to her CIA colleague, Peabody, but makes it clear she's not done fighting. The twist is that she was never fully on either side, and her true loyalty was always to herself and her own mission.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spy thrillers and non-stop action
